method: Primary documents opened with the connected web tool. Retrieval success is not an independent expert review or proof that all linked guidance is the newest revision.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-30 Revision 1: Guide for Conducting Risk Assessments
sources.scope: Stable risk terms and scenario/context reasoning; fictional examples and scoring caveats are original teaching.

sources.title: NIST Cybersecurity Framework resource center
sources.scope: Risk-management framing and governance; not a claim of CSF implementation or certification.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-63B-4: Authentication and Authenticator Management
sources.scope: Factor categories, phishing resistance and lifecycle considerations; not full AAL compliance.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-207: Zero Trust Architecture
sources.scope: No implicit trust from network location or asset ownership alone; not a deployment blueprint.

sources.title: NIST FIPS 180-4: Secure Hash Standard
sources.scope: Hash digests detect changed bytes; source planning note says revision was planned. No claim that hashing authenticates a publisher.

sources.title: Python hashlib documentation
sources.scope: Stable SHA-256 API used in tested local example; executed interpreter version is separately recorded.

sources.title: Python hmac documentation
sources.scope: Keyed authentication API and compare_digest; only a public teaching key is used.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-40 Revision 4: Enterprise Patch Management Planning
sources.scope: Identification, prioritization, installation and verification of updates.

sources.title: FIRST CVSS v4.0 User Guide
sources.scope: Severity metrics versus broader local prioritization. No official CVSS calculation implemented.

sources.title: OWASP Logging Cheat Sheet
sources.scope: Purpose, correlation, sensitive-data exclusion and protection of logs; toy threshold is original.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-61 Revision 3: Incident Response Recommendations
sources.scope: Revision 3 finalized April 2025 and supersedes Revision 2; response integrated into CSF 2.0 risk management.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-34 Revision 1: Contingency Planning
sources.scope: Contingency planning concepts. Timing scenario and copy exercise are original, not production validation.

sources.title: RFC 7489: Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting, and Conformance
sources.scope: Domain authentication does not confer elevated delivery trust or prove benign intent. Foundational limited citation, not current configuration advice.

sources.title: FTC Cybersecurity for Small Business
sources.scope: Suspicious requests and independent verification; no third-party contact or real incident conclusion.

limitations.effect: No current exact version, transition, price, domain weights or objective mapping asserted.

limitations.recovery: Official nvlpubs PDF opened successfully and is the cited source.
